As delicious as it is filling!|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Gourmet Meat and Seafood Fries are meals made by [[Cooking]] either [[Raw Gourmet Meat]] or a [[Raw Whole Bird]] with any [[Seafood]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Their default version can be made either by using Seafood that lacks any effect, such as [[Hyrule Bass]]es and [[Sanke Carp]], or by using multiple pieces of Seafood with different effects. Eating these dishes will heal several of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s. Gourmet Meat and Seafood Fries are made using the best cuts of [[Meat]] and Seafood and are considered to be as delicious as they are filling. Based on the type of Seafood used and whether any additional [[Ingredient]]s are added, several different variations of Gourmet Meat and Seafood Fry exist: * '''Chilly Gourmet Meat and Seafood Fry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Gourmet Meat and Seafood Fry}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
A marriage of the choicest cuts of meat and seafood. As delicious as it is filling!|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Chillfin Trout]]s or other cold Ingredients. Eating them will grant Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]] temporarily. * '''Electro Gourmet Meat and Seafood Fry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Gourmet Meat and Seafood Fry}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
A marriage of the choicest cuts of meat and seafood. As delicious as it is filling!|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Voltfin Trout]] or other electric Ingredients. Eating these will increase Link's [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Enduring Gourmet Meat and Seafood Fry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Gourmet Meat and Seafood Fry}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
A marriage of the choicest cuts of meat and seafood. As delicious as it is filling!|Inventory|BotW}} Made using enduring Ingredients. They completely refill and overfill Link's [[Stamina Wheel]] when they are eaten. * '''Energizing Gourmet Meat and Seafood Fry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Gourmet Meat and Seafood Fry}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
A marriage of the choicest cuts of meat and seafood. As delicious as it is filling!|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Staminoka Bass]]es, [[Bright-Eyed Crab]]s, or other energizing Ingredients. If they're eaten, they will replenish a portion of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Hasty Gourmet Meat and Seafood Fry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Gourmet Meat and Seafood Fry}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
A marriage of the choicest cuts of meat and seafood. As delicious as it is filling!|Inventory|BotW}} Made using hasty Ingredients. Consuming these fries will temporarily boost Link's movement speed. * '''Hearty Gourmet Meat and Seafood Fry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Gourmet Meat and Seafood Fry}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
A marriage of the choicest cuts of meat and seafood. As delicious as it is filling!|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Hearty Bass]], [[Hearty Salmon]]s, [[Hearty Blueshell Snail]]s, or other hearty Ingredients. When eaten, they will completely heal all of Link's Hearts and temporarily increase his maximum Hearts. * '''Mighty Gourmet Meat and Seafood Fry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Gourmet Meat and Seafood Fry}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
A marriage of the choicest cuts of meat and seafood. As delicious as it is filling!|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Mighty Carp]], [[Mighty Porgy|Mighty Porgies]], [[Razorclaw Crab]]s, or other mighty Ingredients. When eaten, Link's attack power will be boosted for a short period of time. * '''Sneaky Gourmet Meat and Seafood Fry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Gourmet Meat and Seafood Fry}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
A marriage of the choicest cuts of meat and seafood. As delicious as it is filling!|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Stealthfin Trout]]s or other sneaky Ingredients. If these dishes are eaten, they will temporarily increase Link's [[Stealth]]. * '''Spicy Gourmet Meat and Seafood Fry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Gourmet Meat and Seafood Fry}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
A marriage of the choicest cuts of meat and seafood. As delicious as it is filling!|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Sizzlefin Trout]]s or other spicy Ingredients. Link gains a level of [[Cold Resistance]] when he eats these. * '''Tough Gourmet Meat and Seafood Fry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Gourmet Meat and Seafood Fry}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
A marriage of the choicest cuts of meat and seafood. As delicious as it is filling!|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Armored Carp]], [[Mighty Porgy|Mighty Porgies]], [[Ironshell Crab]]s, or other tough Ingredients. They increase Link's [[Defense]] when eaten. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Meat and Seafood Fry * Prime Meat and Seafood Fry }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Fries, Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Seafood |items= BotW, TotK }}
